content.summary: Accept the locked manuscript in this separately performed final Beta audit as an ordinary computer-assisted proof of M(4,3)≤67 using its stated established imports and recorded finite evidence. Fresh bounded structural checks and substantive repair review identify no necessary revision. This acceptance is neither a whole-proof independent replay nor publication authorization.

findings.statement: The terminal and graph-to-cover interfaces checked anew preserve arbitrary support, actual-member counts and the necessary degree hypotheses.
findings.disposition: No counterexample or uncovered premise was found in the scoped checks below. Earlier counterexamples to stronger variants remain excluded by explicit hypotheses.

findings.statement: External H27 execution and shared-builder dependence remain material assurance limits.
findings.disposition: Sections 2, 3.1 and 7 disclose them. Neither source metadata nor reviewer agreement is treated as their discharge.

revisions.action: Reassessed the final H27 paragraph against both superseding addenda, the identifier clarification and its numerical sensitivity.
revisions.result: The theorem import remains explicit; commit/tree clarification supplies no historical-run authentication and does not extend the literature cutoff.

revisions.action: Performed new bounded literal-set and coefficient-identity checks, separately from the round-ten vote.
revisions.result: Results are saved under checks/final01/beta. No solver, full finite-suite replay, compiler or new literature search was run.

checks.scope: Section 4.5: D17 terminal bound after completed trace exclusions
checks.method: Independently enumerated every allowed core trace and disjoint hitting pair for P9+P8-i1, P9+P8-i2 and P9+Q8; reconstructed transversal capacities.
checks.observation: The trace domains have 119,119,147 members and 132,143,132 disjoint hitting pairs. Every such pair contains a pure-Y transversal. P9 has eleven transversal triples; its nine actual root cones leave capacity one each, while the two exceptions allow two each. Hence removing at most13 members leaves an intersecting family, giving 13+27=40<51. Arbitrary exterior completions remain counted.

checks.scope: Section 5.1: D16 image reduction, cyclic inverse and independent star support
checks.method: Tested the explicit deletion map on every edge for k=2,…,6, all inverse coefficient identities, and independent sets through size k+1 for k=3,…,6.
checks.observation: All maps preserve edges; the inverse identities hold. The 33,89,225,545 independent sets lie in cyclic k-windows, with none of size k+1. Jin has strict margin480−476=4; A1/A2 contradict68>54 and136>135. A window of mass≥24 supplies at least8 nonstar covers against the recorded full-cover cap1. No complete-blowup assumption enters.

checks.scope: Section 6: direct A3 positivity and actual deletion-cover transfer
checks.method: Re-derived the deficit argument, checked the consecutive-fibre coefficient identity and reconstructed the arbitrary-support charging proof.
checks.observation: Neighbour preimages first give b≤27; sum e=12 then gives a≥1, before b≥25 is invoked. The identity a0+a1+a2=25+r5 yields cover requirements10,11,12 against caps2,4,10. After permitted deletions at least13 link triples remain: two support points meet at most10 in D16 and12 in D15. Every cover therefore contains a support C3 or equals P4; triple codegree2 and simplicity justify 2|C3|+|P4| without bounding exterior labels. Deleted cones remain actual capacity consumers.

checks.scope: All historical required repairs and major findings
checks.method: Read the 120 committed submissions and bound author responses; matched all13 exact required-revision IDs to original-reviewer closures and checked their substantive final-source repairs.
checks.observation: Section3 preserves neighbourhood quantifiers, literal definitions, Unicode set difference and safe indexed notation; the companion map names obligations; Section5.2 explicitly chooses a maximum-degree root; Section2 retains classical attribution and corrected H27 disclosures. TYPESET-R1-F1 remains repaired, including the later accidental-link correction. The exact mapping is saved in checks/final01/beta/objection-dispositions.json. No outstanding issue requires a new disposition.

checks.scope: Essential import, formal scope and bounded priority
checks.method: Compared final Sections2/7/8 with the H27 addenda, refresh record, scalar-status note and reproduction entry point.
checks.observation: For intersecting cap h, the A3 positivity guarantee is136−5h: it is1 at27 but−4 at28. H27 cannot silently be weakened. The five Lean roots cover arithmetic hypotheses, not the whole geometry or theorem. The search remains bounded at2026-10-25T13:36:25Z; inaccessible SSRN text and incomplete native coverage persist. The reproduction guide explicitly separates an observed single-leaf replay from inspected recipes and whole-proof reproduction.

scope_assessments.validity: The fixed68-family degree chain is exhaustive and activates cap18 imports only after D19. My accumulated constructive checks and fresh final interfaces support the ordinary proof; I have not independently rebuilt every model row.
scope_assessments.claim_limits: Accept fixed-rank M(4,3)≤67 and the unchanged lower54. Priority remains strongest located comparable improvement at the stated cutoff, with no general sunflower-conjecture, exhaustive novelty or full Lean claim.
scope_assessments.contrary_evidence: Earlier controls refute dropping internal-completion cost, exporting the rho≤6 support bound, treating homomorphisms as complete blowups, or suppressing exterior multiplicities. The locked manuscript retains these guards. No decisive counterexample to its stated theorem emerged.
scope_assessments.methods: Actual complete stars, exact trace multiplicities, strict integer certificates and acyclic coverage have distinct proof obligations. Shared builders remain a dependence; selected independent reconstructions strengthen only their checked scopes.
scope_assessments.reproducibility: The manuscript, evidence and verification hashes match the supplied bindings; the final committed round matches its binding. Named sources, receipts, versions and replay instructions are available. Absolute paths need documented relocation; no clean whole-proof or external H27 replay is certified.
scope_assessments.ethics: Attribution, incomplete source access, same-provider review and absence of independent human certification are explicit. No ethics objection was identified within this audit; no broad-corpus plagiarism certification or organizational independence is inferred.
scope_assessments.unresolved_objections: All13 required changes have both original-reviewer resolutions and substantive repairs retained in the final text; the historical major presentation finding is repaired. Remaining claim-qualified assurance limits are preserved, not erased. Consequently issue_dispositions is empty rather than inventing new closures.
